title: pedicularis yinshanensis
intro: Pedicularis yinshanensis, commonly known as Yinshan Pedicularis, is a plant species belonging to the Orobanchaceae family, a type of parasitic plant. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Pedicularis yinshanensis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
